up: Return all IC50 activity data for the compound CHEMBL3716726 and any of its salt forms against target CHEMBL375. For each matching activity record, provide the following columns: the compound ChEMBL ID (CHEMBL3716726 or any related salt), canonical SMILES, assay ChEMBL ID, assay description, target ChEMBL ID, document PubMed ID (if available), and document DOI. Include all records with standard_type = 'IC50', regardless of units, relation, or data validity flags.
sql:
WITH target_mols AS (
    SELECT parent.molregno
    FROM molecule_dictionary parent
    WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3716726'
    UNION
    SELECT mh.molregno
    FROM molecule_dictionary parent
    JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno
    WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3716726'
)
SELECT
    md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    a.assay_chembl_id,
    ass.description AS assay_description,
    td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
    d.pubmed_id,
    d.doi
FROM activities a
JOIN target_mols tm ON a.molregno = tm.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
    td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL375'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50';
